pixel:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original static tactical RPG character source sheet, detailed pixel art.
Primary request: ONE original adult male knight full body in relaxed neutral standing pose, three-quarter view facing screen right. This is the first of two matched medium studies.
Input images: Image 1 (previous warden proposal) is CLOTHING PALETTE/ARMOR REFERENCE ONLY, do not reproduce its montage, 3D rendering or awkward stance. Images 2 and 3 (earth and woodland floor) are ENVIRONMENT PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY, do not draw them into the output.
Design: natural 7.5-head human proportions; clear uncovered handsome but weathered adult face, short dark brown hair, visible brow/eyes/nose/mouth, calm expression. Restrained dark navy knee-above split tabard over a fitted worn blue-steel breastplate, modest brass edge trim, segmented small pauldrons, chainmail visible only at flexible joints, brown leather belt and diagonal strap, fitted dark trousers. Both hands wear convincing brown leather gloves with steel protection. Two straight legs align hip-knee-ankle vertically, feet only hip width apart, weight evenly supported, no bow legs, no crouching, no wide combat stance. Proportional ordinary leather boots with modest toes and slim ankles, no giant cuffs or clown shoes. Arms at rest beside torso, near hand closed around an EMPTY grip aperture at upper thigh level, wrist neutral; other hand relaxed and fully visible.
View: shallow downward orthographic tactical view, camera elevation approximately 18 degrees, body turned about 30 degrees from frontal toward screen right; show BOTH eyes and the front and side of armor. Entire body and both soles visible.
Style/medium: authored HIGH DETAIL PIXEL ART at approximately 180 pixels body height represented as a crisp 4x pixel enlargement. Deliberate single consistent square pixel grid, clean clusters, restrained approximately 48-color palette, no smooth antialiasing, no blurry pseudo pixel mosaic, no photorealism, no 3D render. Face has 18-22 native pixels of height. Steel highlights broad enough to read at gameplay size; navy cloth lighter than background, warm leather distinct from skin. Subtle upper-left warm light, clear soft midtones, no blacked out legs.
Composition: transparent 1024x1024 square source sheet. Exactly TWO separated objects: the knight centered around x=370 occupying roughly x=140..650 and y=80..915; and ONE standalone straight sword in clear empty space on the far right around x=840, with pommel UP, handle above guard, blade DOWN, visible whole length, approximately 55 percent of body height. Sword has straight rigid tapered steel blade, simple straight crossguard, dark brown leather grip and small brass pommel. Do NOT put a sword or scabbard on the character, no shield. At least 100px transparent gutter between character and standalone sword. No overlap between objects.
Lighting/mood: grounded low fantasy matching existing warm earth and olive woodland environment, steel/navy/aged brass, no magical glow.
Constraints: transparent background with true alpha, no floor, no cast shadow, no scenery, no additional character, no portrait inset, no labels, no writing, no borders, no watermark. Show the complete relaxed figure and separate sword without cropping.
